integrity: The all-orders result follows from an explicit structural characterization of total restrained dominating sets. Exact set-partition enumeration through order 8 is corroborative only. The initiating preprint and open-access journal text were inspected, and current and prior owned ledgers were searched for overlap.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to connected complete multipartite graphs. The complete, complete-bipartite, star, and triangle boundary values are prior coverage; the new content is the at-least-three-part multipartite classification and the unified formula. Search cannot rule out a poorly indexed equivalent statement.
title: Total restrained coalition numbers of complete multipartite graphs
